intent: Split two more linux_configuration scripts under the cap, and defer a third whose globals cross every candidate seam.
scope: single_use/utils/setup_offline_docs.sh (713 -> 121) + offline_python, offline_cpp, offline_js, offline_rust, offline_index, offline_status
changes: setup_offline_docs.sh needed six libs, carved one language at a time: the first cut left offline_cpp at 545 lines because it had swallowed JS and Rust too.
setup_offline_docs.sh had no SCRIPT_DIR at all - the second script in this effort where the split had to add one.
optimize_arch_desktop.sh's libs had chained (arch_cpu sourcing the other two); flattened so the entry sources all three. Fourth instance of that bug.

libre_translate.sh was reverted. Its API_KEY, GENERATED and seventeen other globals are written on one side of any seam and read on the other. Exporting GENERATED fixed one warning and revealed eighteen more, which is the signal that the seam is imaginary rather than that the fix is wrong.

verification.evidence: Both now report 'libs sourced, functions defined'. Three real failures first: a missing SCRIPT_DIR, the chained arch libs, and the libre_translate globals.
shellcheck - which lints each lib in isolation - shfmt, the shebang hook and jscpd all pass.

verification.command: git checkout HEAD -- libre_translate.sh, rm its libs, shellcheck -x, ls the lib dir
verification.evidence: Restored to 488 lines and clean, with unity_handler.sh from an earlier commit still present - checked by listing rather than assumed.
Neither entry script nor any of the seven libs is listed. Repo total is 90, down from 183.

risks: Neither script was run: one downloads documentation archives over the network, the other writes sysctl, udev and NVIDIA settings. The stubbed run proves reachability, not behaviour.

libre_translate.sh joins the deferred list. Unlike the others it is not one shared array but a broad style - nearly twenty globals - so splitting it means converting them to parameters or accepting a suppression.
rollback: git revert the commit; both scripts return to 713 and 623 lines and the seven libs disappear.
After rollback, re-run bash -n and shellcheck on the restored scripts.
